author.name: Data Dave
author.role: Builds secure, scalable data pipelines and manages storage infrastructure. Focuses on high-quality data operations and robust data governance. Collaborates on exploring data and managing data quality to support model development.

challenge.name: The Midnight Deadline
challenge.description: The nightly data job is failing to finish before the store managers open the ordering app. #reliability_ruth# demands an automated validation layer to catch bad data instantly so the morning window is never missed again. #data_dave# insists on keeping the process manual for now, arguing that the infrastructure costs are too high and the current manual checks are sufficient to manage the risk.

output.content: I have reviewed the proposal for an automated validation layer on the nightly data job. While I understand the urgency regarding the morning order window, I cannot approve the shift to full automation at this stage. The infrastructure costs required to build and maintain that layer are too high for our current budget. I insist that the validation process remains manual for now. The existing checks are sufficient to manage the risk, and we will not cross the line into automated validation until the financial justification is clear. This is a firm position, and I will not support any changes that bypass this cost constraint.
output.reclassify_reason: The author explicitly defines the current cost constraint as a firm line that will not be crossed, stating they will not support any changes that bypass this limit.
